properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: Site occupied by existing commercial buildings that have latterly only been utilised for storage purposes. Identified for potential redevelopment following demolition. An application for clearance of the site construction of 7 dwellings was permitted in 2010 (09/B/0553). A further application to amend the permitted scheme, adding another dwelling was permitted in 2013 (13/00403/FUL). This increased the total yield to 8 homes. Under-construction, with only 1 unit now remaining outstanding. Forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
